About RNEx Trust

Built by neighbours,
for neighbours.

RNEx Trust (Regd.) was founded by residents of Raj Nagar Extension who saw the same families, the same WhatsApp groups, and the same gaps — in healthcare awareness, in support for children's education, in the small acts of welfare no single household can carry alone.

We are a registered public charitable trust under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882, with NGO Darpan, Udyam, and FSSAI registrations in place. Every rupee received is accounted for and applied solely toward our charitable objects — never to private benefit of any trustee or member.

Reg. No. 202600739017949

01

Community-rooted

Every trustee lives in the community we serve. We work alongside RWAs and apartment associations, not at a distance from them.

02

Fully accountable

Annual audits, recorded minutes for every meeting, and transparent use of funds — governance is not an afterthought here.

03

Non-profit, always

No surplus is ever distributed to trustees or their families. What is raised for the community stays with the community.

What We Work On

Four Areas of Focus

Our trust deed sets out broad charitable objects. In practice, our work today centres on four areas.

🎓

Education

Scholarship support, books and uniforms for children from economically weaker families, and digital literacy drives.

❤️

Health Awareness

Free and subsidised health check-up camps, blood donation drives, and wellness sessions in partnership with local hospitals.

👪

Women & Child Development

Self-reliance programmes for women, skill training, and welfare support for children, the elderly, and persons with disabilities.

🌍

Social & Civic Work

Environmental drives, cleanliness campaigns, disaster relief support, and awareness of government welfare schemes.

About Tax-Deductible Receipts (80G)

RNEx Trust is a newly registered public charitable trust (2026) and has not yet obtained 80G registration under the Income Tax Act, which is what allows donors to claim a tax deduction. We are aware of this requirement and intend to apply for it. Once approved, this section will be updated and donation receipts will reflect 80G details. Until then, please treat any contribution as a donation without tax-deduction benefit.

Cancellation & Refund Policy

Last updated: August 2026

Membership Subscriptions (Sathi)

Sathi memberships are recurring subscriptions charged monthly or yearly. You may cancel your subscription at any time by writing to connect@rnextrust.com or by WhatsApp at +91 90120 95151. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No partial refunds are issued for the remaining period of the current cycle.

One-Time Payments (Mitra / Donations)

Mitra lifetime memberships and donations are one-time payments. As these directly fund charitable activities of RNEx Trust (Regd.), they are generally non-refundable. In case of a payment error or duplicate charge, please contact us within 7 days at connect@rnextrust.com with your payment ID and we will process a full refund within 5-7 working days.

T-Shirt Orders

T-shirts are custom-printed and dispatched within 10-15 working days of payment. Cancellation of T-shirt orders is accepted within 24 hours of payment. After dispatch, returns are accepted only in case of manufacturing defects. Please contact connect@rnextrust.com with photographic evidence within 48 hours of delivery.

How to Request a Refund

Email connect@rnextrust.com with your name, payment ID, amount, and reason. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 working days.

Contact

For any cancellation or refund queries: connect@rnextrust.com | +91 90120 95151

Shipping & Exchange Policy

Last updated: August 2026

T-Shirt Delivery

RNEx Trust T-shirts are dispatched via reputed courier partners (Blue Dart, Delhivery, or similar) to the address provided at the time of registration. Delivery typically takes 5-7 working days after dispatch. A tracking number will be shared via email and WhatsApp once the order is shipped.

Delivery Area

We currently ship T-shirts within India only, primarily to Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad and surrounding areas. For other locations, please contact us before placing an order to confirm availability.

Shipping Charges

Shipping charges, if any, are included in the T-shirt price of ₹800 per piece. No additional delivery charges are levied.

Exchange Policy

Size exchanges are accepted within 7 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. The T-shirt must be unused, unwashed, and in original condition with tags intact. To request an exchange, contact connect@rnextrust.com with your membership ID, order details, and the size you require. Return shipping for exchanges must be arranged by the member.

Damaged or Wrong Item

If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please email us at connect@rnextrust.com with photographic evidence within 48 hours of delivery. We will arrange a replacement at no additional cost.

Membership ID Cards

Membership ID cards for Mitra members are dispatched after photo verification. No physical delivery charges apply.

Contact

For shipping queries: connect@rnextrust.com | +91 90120 95151 (WhatsApp)
